correctness.rationale: PASS: Idealized three-species carbon equilibrium has x=[H+]/K1>0, r=K2/K1>0, C/A=(x²+x+r)/(x+2r) with positive derivative onto C/A>1/2. Exact second pH derivative is a positive factor times P_r=x³+6rx²+(16r²-r)x+2r². Symbolic differentiation and exact discriminant -4r³(4r-1)²(112r-1) were recomputed independently; at r=1/112, P=(8x+1)(28x-1)²/6272, root x=1/28 maps to C/A=6/7. Cubic sign and Descartes analysis yield strict convexity for r>=1/112 (isolated zero curvature at equality), exactly two inflections and +,-,+ for r<1/112. Taylor expansion yields concentration gap 8A/3 sqrt(1/112-r)+O(A(1/112-r)). Jensen and local reverse Jensen give claimed pooling-bias signs; no universality asserted when mixing across regions.
